podcasts.name: Tech Snippets Today with Joseph Raczynski
podcasts.title: The 90% Code: When AI Augmentation Turns Into Human Deletion with Sonali Sharma
podcasts.description: Across virtually every industry today, billions of dollars are flowing into artificial intelligence. Boardrooms are celebrating instant productivity gains, automated workflows, and algorithmic efficiency. But underneath the hype, a quiet crisis is taking hold. We are adopting AI tools originally built to augment human judgment, only to watch organizations use them to replace it. Systems designed to signal uncertainty are being treated as infallible authorities. When expected returns evaporate or workforce capabilities degrade, executives rush to blame the algorithm. But what if the code isn’t at fault, what if it's in our governance, management, and organizational design? Today, we are diving deep into the "Alignment Gap", the dangerous divide between how AI is designed and how companies actually deploy it. We're exploring what happens when organizations quietly become "renters of intelligence" rather than owners of true capability, and how leaders must rewrite the rules of power in the AI era.
